name: Dried bamboo shoot
summary: Dried bamboo shoot is one of the forest goods Thai and Muong sellers bring down to Phố Đoàn market, sold beside honey and banana flower.
origin: Phố Đoàn market, xã Pù Luông. Source: The Thanh Hoa Department of Culture, Sports and Tourism, 26 Sep 2026.
howToEat: Buy it at the market to carry home.
where: Phố Đoàn market, on Thursday and Sunday.
seoTitle: Dried bamboo shoot in Pu Luong — a Pho Doan good
seoDescription: Măng khô is the dried forest bamboo shoot Thai and Muong sellers bring to Phố Đoàn on Thursday and Sunday.
